Sorry na lang, AI… pero hindi mo kayang kopyahin ang gawa ni President @bongbongmarcos.

Real leadership, real results.

From @pcogovph:

President @bongbongmarcos has ordered the immediate reconstruction of the fire-damaged building of San Francisco High School in Quezon City, along with the replacement of destroyed school equipment and materials used by students and teachers. The President also directed authorities to inspect the electrical systems of old school buildings to prevent similar incidents.

During his visit to the school, PBBM highlighted the swift response of the Bureau of Fire Protection, which was able to put out the fire within 30 minutes, as well as the quick action of the school administration in ensuring that classes could continue.

PBBM | #SalamatPBBM | #BuildBetterMore | #MarcosPaRin | #BagongPilipinas | #PBBMgoodnews |

[6:40PM] #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate

Slow and steady movement on Broad Street, stretching to Apongbon underneath the bridge, connecting Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo, due to market activities and the evening rush hour.

Unimpeded traffic flow observed on Eko Bridge by NEPA Intersection, inward bound to Apongbon.

Smooth traffic movement descending Eko Bridge, inward CMS, encompassing Elegbeta Mini Stadium and Ebute-Ero Market.

Good traffic from Ebute-Ero Market inward Leventist, through UBA Roundabout, connecting inner and outer Marina.

The current traffic situation is being influenced by market activities and the evening rush hour, with varying traffic flow rates across different locations.

#FollowLASTMA

[6:45PM] #Agege #TrafficUpdate 

Congested movement from Fumec inward Acme Junction, down to Metal Box, attributed to the evening rush hour.
Fast-paced traffic flow on Oba Akran, from Dangote U-turn inward Mobil Ashade, connecting Akilo.
Busy traffic on Ijaye Road, both inward and outward, from Odo Eran to Oba Ogunji, due to traffic alternation and high influx.
Rapid movement from Guinness inward Akanni Doherty, with a minor delay observed at Mangoro Ashade due to traffic light alternation.
Good traffic flow from Capitol inward to Oniwaya Junction, down to Alfa Nla.
Congested traffic on Okekoto inward to Shofunde and Agbotikuyo, although the stretch connecting Olufunlayo down to NYSC is experiencing a fast pace.
Busy traffic conditions on Old Abeokuta Road, from Isokoko inward Total underneath the bridge, due to traffic alternation and commuter activities. 
However, the stretch from Nitel down to Oko Oba is moving at a fast pace, with a minor delay observed at Abbatoir due to traffic alternation.

#FollowLASTMA
